data.name: Atmananda
data.gender_notes: Atmananda is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Atmananda is derived from two Sanskrit words: Atma (self or soul) and Ananda (bliss or joy). This name signifies a person who is self-contented and experiences inner peace and happiness. The name Atmananda carries the meaning “Self-contented, Blissful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Atmananda usually hope their child will grow to embody self-contented, blissful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is content with the self and experiences inner joy and peace.
data.etymology: Atmananda belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Self-contented, Blissful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atmananda total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

The name is in line with Vedantic wisdom that strongly advocates for the importance of the self in one's journey towards enlightenment.
